name: Executioner’s Hood
subjectPrompt: A single animate dungeon predator which imitates a medieval executioner's hood. It is a soft bag of dull charcoal-black leathery material, with two plain dark eye-holes and a rounded, drooping peak. Show its whole silhouette by itself, hunching upright from the base like a living cloak as the lower rim twists open slightly. A few thin black fibrous tendrils curl low from the inside of that lower rim. The two eye-holes are empty cutouts through soft organic hide, with no glow or eyes. Give the tactile folds a subtle weathered skin texture and enough reflected warmth to read the black silhouette. No head or person inside, no face, torso, axe, teeth, extra eye-holes, bloody elements or cranium. Use the second reference for the soft shape of the hood only, without the human figure.

name: Hangman Tree
subjectPrompt: A single thick predatory oak that could pass for an ordinary tree at a glance. Root flares are shallow and wide, the ridged bark is dark furrowed umber, and a sparse crown has small isolated tufts of muted olive oak leaves and angular branches. Hang seven sinewy, organically grown dark vines from separate branches, their curled tips suggesting loose loops. All vines empty and made of plant material. A shadowed hollow opens high on the trunk under the crooked crotch of the crown. Tiny raised knot clusters high on the trunk and a closed old scar low on it hint at senses and an interior. No carved or human face, no eyes, no mouth full of teeth, no humanoid limbs, no rope, no people or animals. Show the crown and exposed roots in full. Use the second reference for the sinewy vines and looming oak proportions only, and omit the people shown there.
